voteResult: 6/6 unanimous Option A: freeze GNN contract first
description: GNN interface contract for the IX execution hot path. All callers (Shannon, exec.js, hookwall, grammar) must conform to this interface.

ok.description: Whether the GNN gate processed successfully

nextVerb.description: GNN predicted next verb in chain

recorded.description: Whether the edge was persisted to NDJSON

eventId.description: ID of the recorded graph event

allow.description: GNN failure does NOT block — degrades gracefully

reason.description: Why GNN failed (cold start, store error, etc)

rules.coldStart: GNN MUST pass (allow=true) when it has no data. It records the edge for future learning.
rules.blockCondition: GNN blocks ONLY when score >= 9 AND prediction.confidence > 0.8 flagging suspicious pattern.
rules.failureMode: GNN failure returns degraded=true, allow=true. NEVER blocks on its own failure.
rules.recording: Every call MUST be recorded as a graph edge, even on error.
rules.shannonConsumes: Shannon gate receives GNN output and may use score + prediction for its own decision.
rules.grammarConsumes: Grammar verb-factory receives GNN output to inform routing and pre-spawn decisions.
